statements.statement: The patient presents with persistent palpitations
The patient has a history of symptomatic bradycardia consistent with sick sinus syndrome
The diagnosis codes on the claim are I49.5, I49.9 and R00.2
CPT code 93226 represents a 48-hour Holter monitoring study
The service is for continuous ambulatory electrocardiographic evaluation
The claim was denied under reason code CO-22
The denial reason is that care may be covered by another payer in accordance with coordination of benefits protocols
The service is medically necessary to document the correlation between the symptoms and the arrhythmia
